newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 17.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 17.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- NATO and EU accession are the priorities of Hungary's foreign policy, Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs said.
- The government said a 1.5 to two percent real wage growth is possible in 1998.
- The government said the business sphere should not raise wages disproportionately quicker than the public sector.
- The Mayor of Cluj, Romania refused to meet Hungary's new consul there.
- Newspapers say the opposition KDNP party's parliamentary group could be dissolved by autumn.
